composition_label: Guided setup -> Knowledge-base answers -> Web research

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written in this isolated build directory.

input.question: Nonempty text
input.setup: product; steps with unique id, requires IDs, required boolean; completed IDs
input.knowledge: Documents with unique id, product, text
input.research: allowlisted_hosts and pages with unique id, url, title, text

shared_schema.output: schema_version, fixture_label, status (ok or blocked), stages in execution order
shared_schema.context: Validated product and original question, propagated without alteration
shared_schema.evidence: id, kind (knowledge/web), text, url, title; knowledge URL/title are null
shared_schema.validation: Strict fields, bounded strings/lists, unique IDs, acyclic prerequisite graph, completed prerequisite closure; shared validate_stage boundaries; strict exact-excerpt answer grounding
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with schema_version 1, status error and error string; CLI exit 2

cross_stage_handoffs.consumed: Validated context, readiness and product/question query. Product scopes FAQ documents; incomplete required setup blocks retrieval.
Validated context, readiness, query and FAQ source IDs. FAQ citations are retained as upstream_source_ids; absence of FAQ evidence permits research fallback.

behavior.guided: Validate prerequisite DAG and completed closure; track completed, remaining, available, total and completed_count. Optional steps do not block ready status.
behavior.faq: Filter exact product, rank text by distinct non-stopword question-token overlap; ties sort by ID; return at most three exact cited excerpts or explicit no_relevant_evidence abstention.
behavior.web: Ingest supplied synthetic page snapshots, never fetch. HTTPS, exact allowlisted DNS host, no credentials, no nonstandard port, fragment, whitespace or backslash. Retrieve with FAQ-propagated question and retain original URL, title, source ID and exact excerpt.
behavior.research_policy: Research runs after every ready FAQ result, including FAQ abstention. It provides independent findings rather than claiming to verify FAQ claims.
behavior.optional_callable: run_pipeline(request, answerer=None); injected callable(stage, query, evidence) returns answer and source_ids. Only exact concatenated cited excerpts are accepted. No live provider.
behavior.determinism: Stable ranking and input-order onboarding tracking; no clock, randomness, network or provider calls.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout. Valid blocked onboarding is a normal result with exit 0. File, JSON and validation failures exit 2.

included: Grounded extractive FAQ answers and abstention
Allowlisted snapshot ingestion and provenance-preserving findings
Standard-library unittest and subprocess CLI tests
excluded: Network fetching, redirects, DNS resolution or live freshness guarantees
Live LLM/model providers or generative semantic grounding
Semantic entailment, stemming or confidence calibration
Persistent database, authentication, UI or enterprise deployment
Real customer or external web data
